cloud.title: Connect your LazyPot account
cloud.description: Paste the integration token from your LazyPot account settings (website or app) — this is not your LazyPot login password.

local.title: LazyPots on your home network
local.description: Pots set up with the LazyPot integration switched on send their readings straight to Home Assistant after every check-in. Nothing goes through the internet and no account is needed. Each pot appears here by itself the first time it reports, which can take a few minutes after setup.

zeroconf_confirm.title: New LazyPot found
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} is on your network. Add LazyPots on this network to Home Assistant? It appears with its readings at its next check-in, and any other LazyPot that reports here is added automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your LazyPot account
reauth_confirm.description: Your LazyPot integration token was rejected. It may have expired or been revoked. Generate a new token in your LazyPot account settings (website or app) and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: Token was rejected. Generate a new one from your LazyPot account settings.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the LazyPot smart-home API.

abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different LazyPot account. Use a token from the account this integration was set up with.
